text:
will: kicking off v2.9.0 to global at 22:00 PT. This one introduces a split-path routing flag `route-split-alpha` (fast-path vs safe-path). change window 22:00-23:00 PT. plan is cohorted enable with traffic shaping, not just percent. @deploy-bot please queue.

deploy-bot: Job D-120555 scheduled by will for 22:00 PT. Ramp plan: pilot 1% fast-path -> 5% (fast) + 5% safe -> 20% split (80/20 fast/safe) -> 50% split (90/10) -> 100% mostly fast. Holdpoints 6m. Will tag telemetry with deploy_id.

sara: Ping on rollback triggers?

will: Rollback triggers: 5m error rate >1.6x baseline OR p95 >420ms OR customer 5xx >=0.5%. Add cost-circuit: abort if token throughput >1.8x projected OR cost delta >$120/hr for cohort. On abort: `deploy-bot abort D-120555` then `scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.8.7` and set `route-split-alpha=false` globally. Also we have a fast->safe circuit: if feature hits error spike, auto-fall back to safe-path only for that cohort (no full rollback) — ops will monitor.

devops: I'll wire the circuit to flip flagsafe for affected cohorts via `scripts/flip_to_safe.sh <cohort>`. Keep an eye on token usage.

ops-bot: Muting non-critical alerts for 70m from 22:00 PT (group: team-noise). Critical and cost alerts remain.

will: Ramp matrix (compact):
```
step1: pilot-dev (1% fast-path) - hold 6m
step2: internal-beta (5% fast + 5% safe) - hold 6m
step3: regional-eu (20% split: 80% fast / 20% safe) - hold 6m
step4: global-major (50% split: 90% fast / 10% safe) - hold 6m
step5: full (100% fast-path) - monitor 25m
backout: route-split-alpha=false; pin router v2.8.7
```

sara: Owners?

will: I'll own steps 1-2. lee owns steps 3-4. sara owns the final enable. devops on circuit flips and cache-ttl ops.

lee: note  during region ramps we'll decrease cache-ttl to 20s to avoid stale session routes; run `scripts/kv_sync_check.sh <region>` after flips.

pager-bot: Reminder: change window ends 23:00 PT. Auto-abort scheduled at 23:05 if unresolved.

deploy-bot: Executing step1 in 20s: `scripts/rollout_toggle.sh route-split-alpha pilot-dev fast true`

deploy-bot: Step1 complete at 22:00:18 - pilot-dev fast-path=1%. tags: D-120555 step=1 cohort=pilot-dev

devops: +4m: pilot metrics ok, p50 +7ms. No 5xx. Circuit healthy. Proceeding to step2 in 2m.

will: Starting step2 now. deploy-bot run: fast=5% safe=5% for internal-beta.

deploy-bot: Step2 started at 22:08:11 - internal-beta fast=5 safe=5. Holding 6m.

sara: +3m into step2: brief p95 bump to 360ms for 90s then recovered. No error rate increase. Watching.

lee: For step3 we will pre-seed safe-path instances to reduce cold starts. devops please confirm pre-seed script run.

devops: Pre-seed done for regional-eu nodes. Also lowered cache-ttl to 20s.

deploy-bot: Starting step3 at 22:22:02 - regional-eu fast/safe = 80/20. Running health checks.

sara: +2m into step3: small shard s-9 saw elevated latency. I'm pausing progress and requesting devops run `scripts/flip_to_safe.sh regional-eu s-9`.

devops: Executed `scripts/flip_to_safe.sh regional-eu s-9` - shard s-9 now on safe-path only. Telemetry: action=partial-circuit flip_cohort=regional-eu shard=s-9

ops-bot: Autoscale triggered for regional-eu safe-path pool +1 node; token throughput within expected bounds.

lee: post-flip p95 returned to baseline. Proceeding to finish step3 hold then step4. If we see repeat across multiple shards we'll abort full deploy.

will: emergency commands for quick reference: `deploy-bot abort D-120555` and `scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.8.7`. Use circuit flip if shard-scoped.

pager-bot: At 22:38 PT, cost alert threshold check scheduled for +4m.

sara: +6m step3 hold complete. No global impact. Moving to step4 in 90s. lee take lead.

lee: Starting step4 at 22:41:05 - global-major fast/safe = 90/10. Holding 6m. cache-ttl still 20s.

devops: Monitoring cost streams. No cost surge currently.

sara: +3m into step4: token throughput trending +1.4x predicted for one cohort but cost <= threshold. Continue to monitor.

lee: Hold complete and metrics green. Handing to sara for final enable.

sara: Final check +10m pre-enable: p95 stable, errors normal, cost within expected. Proceeding to full enable in 2m.

deploy-bot: Final enable executed at 22:58:12 - route-split-alpha fast-path=100% for all cohorts. tags: D-120555 step=5 cohort=all

sara: Final monitor started (25m). Posting +5m and +20m updates.

will: Release notes blurb for support/ops: "v2.9.0: split-path routing (route-split-alpha) with staged cohort rollouts; shard-level safe-path circuit available to mitigate partial regressions; rollback criteria in eng-releases thread."

devops: +5m: metrics stable. No circuit trips.

ops-bot: +20m: final-check green. No customer-facing incidents. Unmuting alerts.

will: Thanks team. I'll publish full release notes and close. If anyone sees late regressions reopen. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
